newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Cementos Diamante's Q1 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Cementos Diamante's Q1 net falls.

text.p: The first-quarter net profit of Colombia's Cementos Diamante fell 19.6 percent from the same period a year ago to 9.2 billion pesos, the cement maker said in a statement.
The company, which is owned by Cementos Mexicanos, said net profits per share were 84.9 billion during the first- quarter and that operating income for the quarter rose 61 percent to 23.1 billion.

The statement said the drop in net profits for the quarter was largely due to costs associated with the acquisition of a rival cement maker and the expansion of Diamante's Ibague plant in central Tolima province.
